verdict.rationale: Bulk operations do appear in the evidence, but only in narrow forms. The changelog notes that wiping and deleting dynamic partitions happens in a single action, including for multi-partitioned assets. The dbt docs say you can run subsets of many dbt models, seeds and snapshots via the UI or APIs. Missing for 10: a general bulk-action capability across arbitrary assets, runs or partitions (e.g. backfills, bulk re-execute or cancel); evidence that bulk actions are reachable through AI-native surfaces like the MCP server or the dg CLI; independent or hands-on corroboration.
